results.sql:
SELECT
      l_orderkey,
      l_linenumber,
      l_extendedprice,
      AVG(l_extendedprice) OVER (PARTITION BY l_orderkey) AS order_avg_extendedprice
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE
      l_shipmode = 'AIR'
      AND l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01'
      AND l_shipdate <= '1997-12-31'
      AND l_extendedprice > AVG(l_extendedprice) OVER (PARTITION BY l_orderkey)
    ORDER BY
      l_orderkey ASC,
      l_linenumber ASC

    FROM partsupp

    ```sql
    s.s_name,
    ```

```sql
SELECT 
```
    l_orderkey, 
    l_linenumber, 
    p_name, 
    (l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    lineitem
JOIN 
    part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey
WHERE 
    l_shipmode = 'FOB' 
    AND p_container = 'LG DRUM'
    AND (l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) = (
        SELECT MAX(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount))
        FROM 
            lineitem
        JOIN 
            part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey
        WHERE 
            l_shipmode = 'FOB' 
            AND p_container = 'LG DRUM'
    )
ORDER BY 
    l_orderkey ASC, 
    l_linenumber ASC

SELECT
    c_mktsegment,
    AVG(customer_total) AS avg_customer_total_spending
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.c_mktsegment,
        SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS customer_total
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN
        customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    WHERE
        DATE_PART('year', o.o_orderdate) = 1996
        AND o.o_orderpriority = '4-NOT SPECIFIED'
    GROUP BY
        c.c_custkey,
        c.c_mktsegment
)
GROUP BY
    c_mktsegment
ORDER BY
    avg_customer_total_spending DESC,
    c_mktsegment ASC

WHERE
  c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE'
  AND o.o_orderdate >= '1992-01-01'

GROUP BY
  p.p_partkey,

ORDER BY
  total_net_revenue DESC,
  p.p_partkey ASC
LIMIT 10

    ```sql
SELECT
    ```
    c_mktsegment AS market_segment,
    SUM(l_extendedprice) AS total_gross_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l_suppkey) AS distinct_supplier_count
FROM
    lineitem
JOIN
    orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey
JOIN
    customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey
JOIN
    nation ON customer.c_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey
JOIN
    region ON nation.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey
WHERE
    region.r_name = 'ASIA'
    AND YEAR(orders.o_orderdate) = 1994
GROUP BY
    c_mktsegment
ORDER BY
    total_gross_revenue DESC,
    market_segment ASC

    ```sql
SELECT
    ```
            ```sql
    n.n_name,
            ```
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' THEN l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS urgent_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority = '5-LOW' THEN l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS low_revenue
FROM
    nation n
    JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
    AND l.l_linestatus = 'F'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate <= '1995-12-31'
    AND o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '5-LOW')
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
HAVING
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) > 100000.00
ORDER BY
    n.n_name ASC

WHERE l.l_shipmode = 'REG AIR'

        *   Date range: 1996-01-01 to 1996-12-31 inclusive (l_shipdate).

    ```sql
    SELECT
    ```

SELECT
```sql
    s.s_name,
```
    ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.o_orderdate, l.l_shipdate)), 2) AS avg_fulfillment_days
FROM
    supplier s
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'AMERICA'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1992-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate <= '1992-12-31'
    AND l.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    s.s_name
HAVING
    AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.o_orderdate, l.l_shipdate)) > 45
ORDER BY
    avg_fulfillment_days DESC,
    s.s_name ASC

    customer_name,
    total_order_value,
    rank_in_nation
FROM (
    SELECT 
        n.n_name AS nation_name,
        c.c_name AS customer_name,
        SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, c.c_name ASC) AS rank_in_nation
    FROM customer c
    JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY'
      AND o.o_orderdate >= '1998-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate < '1999-01-01'
    GROUP BY n.n_name, c.c_name
)
WHERE rank_in_nation <= 3
ORDER BY nation_name ASC, rank_in_nation ASC

        WHEN total_qty > 1000 AND total_qty <= 5000 THEN '2_1001-5000'
